references.text: Basic command to consecrate all firstborn to the Lord, both of humans and animals
Command to give all male firstborn of livestock to the Lord
Firstborn of cattle and sheep shall be given to the Lord on the eighth day
All firstborn belong to the Lord, including cattle and sheep
The firstborn of animals already belong to the Lord and cannot be consecrated again
All firstborn belong to the Lord from the day he struck down the firstborn in Egypt
Rules concerning the redemption of firstborn humans and unclean animals, but the firstborn of cattle, sheep, and goats shall not be redeemed
The firstborn of cattle and sheep shall be brought to the place the Lord chooses
